expandedTasks.originalScope:
- [ ] T004 Implement the base registry types and immutable initial metric
  declarations in `src/analytics/evaluation/registry.ts`. Include formula,
  numerator, denominator, direction, minimum cohort, exact threshold,
  applicable profile, fixture digest, evaluator version, and owner-approval
  reference/time fields. Register all ten feature 018 gates verbatim,
  including each formula, numerator/denominator cohort, favorable direction,
  minimum denominator, and threshold literal. Keep cost observed-or-unavailable
  and non-gating; represent the five no-match zero-false-direct-answer result
  separately from the ten-gate registry. Require the configured feature 010
  project-owner approval reference and a valid timestamp strictly earlier
  than the governed batch start; reject missing, equal-time, and post-batch
  approvals. Never synthesize an actor or timestamp. Fail closed on missing,
  zero, or undersized required denominators.
  - Files: `src/analytics/evaluation/registry.ts`,
    `src/analytics/acceptance/18-bootstrap.test.ts`.
  - Depends on: T001–T003.
  - Independent verification: `pnpm build`; `pnpm exec tsx --test --test-name-pattern=registry src/analytics/acceptance/18-bootstrap.test.ts`.
  - Coverage: immutable pre-batch metric registration and explicit gate fields.

- [ ] T005 Implement the independent post-response adjudication API and
  append-only feature-evidence registration in `registry.ts`. The evaluator
  receives the completed response and evaluator-only reference bundle through
  separate parameters; reject reference material found in the worker packet,
  retrieved-card payload, source-skill text, or cached summary. Exercise this
  at the 001-only dependency floor by passing synthetic, shape-compatible
  retrieval, source-skill, and cached-summary additions through the frozen
  worker-context serialization/digest path; do not import or require later
  feature implementations. Require zero reference-answer, relevance-label,
  reference-ID/digest, and planted-fault bytes in the actual serialized
  packet, and prove its digest is computed only from that sanitized packet.
  Add a feature-scoped contribution API that
  accepts the contributing feature owner, exact fixture IDs and content
  digests, parent locked revision, independent expected outcomes and rubric
  digests, and approval actor/reference plus timestamp. Verify authorized
  feature ownership, that the approval reference resolves to an immutable
  owner-authored approval for the canonical contribution digest, byte/digest
  agreement, and that the recorded approval and registry-generated admission
  time are strictly earlier than the target batch start. Do not accept
  caller-supplied admission time. A
  valid contribution creates a
  new immutable child lock revision; changed-ID/content collisions,
  unauthorized owners, missing independent outcomes, and post-start admission
  fail. Preserve all existing expected-outcome and threshold digests. Derive
  this unit's parent-lock fixture from T001/T004 records so its focused check
  does not require the later T006 lock-report unit; T006 serializes the
  initial lock only after this registry unit passes. Keep
  contributed fixture files at feature-owned exact paths such as
  `src/analytics/evaluation/fixtures/contributions/<featureKey>/<contributionId>.json`;
  this manifest owns neither the contribution subtree nor the whole fixtures
  directory. Pin evaluation to the exact contributed revision selected before
  the batch, even if a later registry revision exists. Preserve each
  evidence record's feature owner, case refs, worker/tool/model, harness,
  policy and resource settings, source/prompt/context digests, fixture and
  rubric digests, and observed result. Allow review-disagreement evidence with
  its sampling frame, policy, strata, selection, adjudicator, severity, counts,
  numerator/denominator, uncertainty, and a precision target declared before
  the audit. Mark an
  undersized audit descriptive only, and prove it cannot change the policy or
  metric-threshold digest. Reject reclassification of a tuned development case
  as evaluation within its frozen fixture-set version. Accept later feature
  evidence without permitting it to edit locked fixtures, case roles, answer
  keys, or thresholds. Keep the API case-neutral and leave whole-product
  release aggregation to feature 018. Provide a comparison compatibility
  check: reject comparisons whose task constraints, harness/version, budget,
  fixture IDs, or adjudication protocol differ; matched runs retain identical
  fixture IDs and scoring rubric references.
  - Files: `src/analytics/evaluation/registry.ts`,
    `src/analytics/acceptance/18-bootstrap.test.ts`.
  - Depends on: T004.
  - Independent verification: `pnpm build`; `pnpm exec tsx --test --test-name-pattern=registry src/analytics/acceptance/18-bootstrap.test.ts`.
  - Coverage: reference isolation, post-response scoring boundary, and later
    evidence registration; locked development/evaluation role enforcement and
    descriptive-only disagreement audits.

- [ ] T003 [US2] Implement path/root validation, bounded CSV and `.xlsx` parsing, content hashing, immutable import/version records, duplicate groups and current workbook-sheet grant checks in `src/analytics/import.ts`. Enforce at most 100 files, 1 GiB and 300 seconds before further content reads; larger imports require a separate owner-authorized bounded profile/run. On change, append a source-change event and mark dependent current projections `reassessment_required`; on missing input, mark availability `unavailable` without rewriting provenance. Never move originals. Add `src/analytics/acceptance/019.test.ts` cases for the 99-file corpus, distinct paths with identical bytes, unknown provenance despite a `final` name, changed/missing rescan, 101st-file/byte/time stop, unsafe workbook structure, metadata-only sheets and denied sheet title/cell disclosure.

- [ ] T004 [US2] Implement access-first FTS5 search, `ingestCommittedProjectionV1(CatalogProjectionInputV1)`, append-only `appendCurationEventV1(CatalogCurationEventV1)`, `recordDeniedLookupV1(DeniedLookupEventV1)`, and idempotent `rebuildIndex` in `src/analytics/catalog.ts`. The curation operation MUST validate the current project-owner grant, assign stable event/commit IDs, and persist the immutable actor, target artifact, permitted curation action, access scope, and exact evidence refs through node-009 `commitProjectMemory`; it MUST return the committed event ref and never treat an index edit as durable curation. A denied lookup MUST be recorded as an append-only, access-safe project event through the same node-009 commit path, with principal ref, opaque source ref, operation and safe denial reason, and without protected title/path/sheet/cell metadata. Rebuild MUST replay every committed node-009 project and run manifest revision, including artifact/import/curation records, answer-card records, and typed version-1 catalog projection inputs for ledger attempts, rationale and match assessments. Define and validate `CatalogProjectionInputV1` as a committed, versioned index contribution containing source record/commit refs, access scope, availability, current validity, safe search text and exact artifact/card/attempt/rationale/match refs. Rebuild only from refs reachable through recovered 009 manifest chains; do not import the not-yet-built `023/ledger.ts`, author ledger semantics, mutate source records, or turn index state into authority. Persist import/curation records using node-009 project memory; filter current grants before FTS matching/ranking and before worker-context construction, withholding raw rows/cells, restricted titles/paths/sheet names, rationale and counts. Add `src/analytics/acceptance/019.test.ts` fixtures `f019-curation-commit-rebuild` (commit a curation event through 009, recover with `recoverProjectMemory`, rebuild a deleted/corrupt index, and assert the event and its artifact/evidence refs are restored while canonical source bytes and history remain unchanged) and `f019-t39-restricted-workbook-denial` as supporting 019 catalog/access-boundary coverage for 020-owned proposal T39 (a lookup lacking current workbook/sheet metadata grant MUST be denied before FTS search, matching/ranking and worker-context construction; persist a safe denied-lookup event through 009 with principal/source/operation/reason; assert no protected title, path, sheet name or row value appears in the search response, committed audit payload, or context). Also cover versioned synthetic committed ledger/card/artifact rebuild, preserved attempt and match-assessment refs, scopes, availability, current validity and usage links, access-safe rationale retrieval, imported-versus-result distinction, and zero duplicate or staged promotion.

- [ ] T003 [US2] Add whole-product memory, output and access scoring in `src/analytics/evaluation/evaluator.ts`; measure the 150-card/20-query Hit@3 and five no-match retrieval cohort, 99-file catalog/false-story corpus, 48-signal candidate precision and 32-positive candidate recall plus validation/later use and incompatible reuse, automatic recall, ledger completeness/exact-repeat/false-duplicate/prior-negative retrieval, grant-respecting source/context/viewer access, retained output count/bytes, unwanted CSV/workbook exports, notebook replay, unmanaged-root writes, and matched cold/warm source discovery effort, answer quality and skipped checks.

- [ ] T003 Add synthetic/local integration cases in `src/analytics/acceptance/99.test.ts` for all eight accepted paths: 001 worker boundary, 002 fixed evidence, 003 delegated inquiry, 020 answer recall, 004 source memory, 022 skill activation/use, 005 recurrence/use, and 006 inference. Exercise feature-owned producers, controller consumers, user inspection paths, and injected failures; do not transfer primary acceptance ownership.
